name: Grand Bahama Island Promotion Board
brand_truth: The Bahamas island closest to Florida, with caves at one end and stingrays at the other.
buyer: Florida and US South-East travellers (weekenders, families, divers), cruise and ferry passengers, planning on a phone.

design.signature: Crossing map (Florida coast, ferry/cruise/flight routes to Freeport, 55-mile bracket) plus an island map of the five favourites feeding a west-to-east day planner

current_site_findings: Homepage still links to COVID-19 entry requirements
Book Now panel lists Anchorage-to-Honolulu airports but only two resorts; sign-up shows 'Operation timed out'
Empty 'Learn more about' link and 'Grand Bahama Island Open' tile text
Core pages last edited 2022; flip-books open on another site
55 miles from Florida buried in body copy
pitch_line: Your best line, 55 miles from Florida, is hidden under a COVID notice; this concept turns it into the map a Floridian sees first, then lets them build a day on the island.
assumptions: No phone or email found on scraped pages: CTAs go to their own planning, deals and guide pages
notes: Freeport-based destination marketer: strong local relationship prospect for Balazs. Record niche is tours; built as a destination planner (TouristInformationCenter + TouristDestination schema). Photos hotlinked from grandbahamavacations.com/assets. Getting-here inner page only (things-to-do covered on home and linked to their listings) to stay in budget. interact.mjs flags the nights slider as 'dead' (range input). Org email consent names it 'Grand Bahama Island Tourism Board' at Fidelity Financial Center, Freeport.
